::: {#exr-toppings}
#### Frozen yogurt toppings

A frozen yogurt shop has five toppings:
sprinkles, fudge, granola, berries and nuts.
A customer picks two toppings and may pick the same topping twice.
The order does not matter:
sprinkles then fudge is the same choice as fudge then sprinkles.
Counting such choices is a first step toward counting the subsets of a set.

::: {.callout-tip title="Hint"}

Write each choice as a [set](#def-set) in [roster notation](#def-roster-notation),
such as $\set{\text{sprinkles}, \text{fudge}}$.
Listing an element twice does not add an element (@exm-roster-notation).
An [ordered pair](#def-ordered-pair) of toppings keeps the order of the picks.

:::

Compute the number of different choices.

:::
